column1: # Royal Canin import plan — one row per CSV row (33 rows → 28 products).
# Rows sharing product_key become one product with several variants; the first
# row of a key is the default variant and supplies the product-level fields.
# Grouping follows reference/data-tables.md §2: lifestage + pack weight are
# variant axes; breed size is NOT (Mini/Medium/Maxi = separate products); a
# named breed groups a line. Lifestage is NOT a variant axis (user rule
# 2026-08-12): Puppy and Adult of the same line are separate products, because
# the packaging artwork/colour changes with lifestage. Variant axes = pack size,
# flavor and texture (gravy/jelly) — same bag, option named on a band.
# sku: RC article code (wmsCode) when the site sells that exact pack, else
# pricing: per_kg = sold by weight (dry kibble) → the API takes `price_per_kg`
# (= price / weight_kg, 2dp) + `weight` and IGNORES `price`; product-weight is
# left off the attrs because the admin derives it from the pack weight.
# fixed = sold by the unit (pouch/can/multipack/tin) → `price` as before.
